authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10507 subsection 2 explicitly supplies the eat sense, with Dameli žu-, Gawri and Kalasha žu-, and Khowar žib-. Turner tentatively explains Khowar b through expressive doubling in *yuvvati; this uncertainty is retained. Selected survey forms preserve their infinitive/finite endings and vowel length, and Dameli źīny ā retains the original spacing. The existing canonical node is 10507 (no separate subsection-2 node); its displayed yokes gloss does not exhaust the primary article. The distinct grain-eating ravate family at 10645 was compared and is not substituted. Local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: źūnūs.
